## Safety checklist

- [ ] All prose, code comments, and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] No credentials, restricted data, model binaries, predictions, or logs are included.
- [ ] Leakage controls and outer-fold preprocessing are documented.
- [ ] Tests, source checks, and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Submission-path changes were reviewed by a non-author teammate.
- [ ] This pull request does not call `vcc submit` automatically.
